verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: the National Council's page for parliamentary print 1266 (nrsr.sk, stored 14 Oct 2026, unchanged on 17 Oct 2026) confirms the title, the four sponsors, receipt on 27 March 2026, the Speaker's decision no. 1336, first reading at the 49th session (resolution no. 1497 of 5 May 2026), the current stage (committee consideration) and the sponsors' letter of 7 September 2026 asking for the bill to be taken at the session beginning on 17 November 2026. The summary and notes are written from the bill text and memorandum.

summary.quote: Ustanovenia odsekov 1 až 3 sa použijú primerane aj na obrazové snímky, zvukové alebo obrazové a zvukové záznamy vytvorené alebo podstatne pozmenené technickým postupom
